spec2def(mciseq.dll mciseq.spec)

# mciseq.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mciseq-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(mciseq_shims OBJECT mcimidi.c)
target_link_libraries(mciseq_shims PRIVATE wine libwinmm libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(mciseq_shims)
target_compile_options(mciseq_shims PRIVATE "-Wno-overflow")
add_cargo_module(mciseq mciseq-cargo mciseq.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mciseq_shims psdk)
